INFORMATION ABOUT
TRAUZAN ELEVATOR

What elevator services does Trauzan provide?

We provide lift installation, repair, maintenance, modernization, passenger and goods lift solutions, and escalator services.

Do you provide annual maintenance contracts (AMC)?

Yes. We offer annual maintenance support. Contact our team to discuss the requirements of your building and equipment.

Do you provide elevator repair services?

Yes. You can contact our team regarding elevator repair and maintenance requirements.

Can an existing elevator be modernized?

Yes. Existing elevator systems can be assessed for suitable modernization options depending on their condition and requirements.

Do you work with residential and commercial buildings?

We cater to residential, commercial and industrial building requirements.

How can I request a quotation?

Visit our contact page or email us with your project details. Our team can discuss the next steps with you.

Where does Trauzan Elevator provide services?

Trauzan Elevator serves Delhi NCR. Contact our team to confirm service availability for your location.
